title: Meena's accessories store
body: Meena runs a mobile phone accessories store in a busy residential colony. She buys earphones, chargers and covers of many brands from a wholesaler and keeps a wide range so that customers can choose. When a company launches new earphones, she displays them at the counter and explains their features to customers. She notes what customers ask for and which models they complain about, and passes this feedback to the company's distributor every month. During festivals she takes part in the company's 'scratch and win' scheme by handing out coupons with every purchase. Her store stays open until late evening, she delivers chargers to the homes of elderly customers, and she allows a few regular customers to pay at the end of the month.
